title: Update 4.7 — Echoes of the Hawk
summary: Tournament event introducing Yoru's Echo, leaderboards, and global cosmetics.
changes: New event: Hawk's Tournament — top 10 placements receive Yoru's Echo.
Added a global leaderboard system with weekly resets.
Buffed Sea Blade — Drown CD reduced from 22s to 18s.
Nerfed Light Fruit — Sacred Yata channel reduced from 3s to 2s.

title: Update 4.6 — Phantom Tides
summary: Phantom Isle expansion with the Cursed Saber and ghoul race awakening.
changes: New island: Phantom Isle (Third Sea, levels 1500–1800).
New mythical sword: Cursed Saber (drop from Cursed Captain).
Ghoul race V3 unlocked: Devour finisher.
Improved underwater rendering on low-end devices.

title: Update 4.5 — Sky High
summary: Skylands rebalanced. Storm Lord made fairer for solo players.
changes: Storm Lord HP reduced from 480k → 380k.
Storm Lord global lightning now telegraphs 0.5s longer.
Skypiean V3 added: Sky Dash mid-air teleport.
Fixed quest 'Cloud Trial' getting stuck after server restart.

title: Update 4.4 — Quality Pass
summary: Hundreds of quality-of-life changes based on community feedback.
changes: Inventory now sorts by rarity by default.
Added a fruit re-roll button at the Mirror Shrine.
Reduced sailing fuel costs by 20%.
Added shoulder-mount tracking for boss raids on the world map.

title: Update 4.3 — Frozen Realms
summary: The Frozen Fjord opens. Ice Fruit awakening unlocked.
changes: New island: Frozen Fjord.
New boss: Glacier Tyrant.
Ice Fruit awakening: gains permanent flight in awakened form.
New cosmetic set: Frostbreaker.

title: Update 4.2 — Hallowed Seas
summary: Limited-time spooky event with cosmetic rewards and the Ghoul race rate doubled.
changes: Ghoul spawn rate temporarily doubled.
Pumpkin cosmetic chest available from any boss.
Halloween-themed ship sails added.
